content.introduction: Oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9%, as SK Hynix shares sank by over 15% on another mixed day for Asian markets. SK Hynix IPO reinvigorated AI trade, boosting Asia stocks. The Nikkei 225 dropped 6.60%, Hang Seng rose 3.67%, S&P/ASX 200 fell 0.80%, and Nifty 50 increased 2.40%. The sources don't provide a definitive answer on commodities news, bond market news, or ETFs news.
